sourceChecks.text: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

wikipediaReadEvidence.locator: Achbor of Edom, lines 108–119: explicitly says the king lists in Genesis and 1 Chronicles name Achbor as father of Baal-hanan; separately treats Achbor of Judah.

profileDecisionJa: 1:49固定WEBの前後文脈で氏名の指示対象を確認。候補外の系譜・同名者は混同せず、曖昧な親族関係を断定しない。
